description:
In the text entry below, paste one or more blocks of code to do as many of the following as possible (title the sections and use the preformatted style for code):

  1. Blink an LED in a pattern.
  2. Blink an LED pattern when a button is pressed.
  3. Adjust the speed of an LED's blink with a Potentiometer.
  4. Fade an LED up and down with PWM.
  5. Adjust the PWM brightness of an LED with a potentiometer.

Advanced

  1. Use a pot to chooses between 3 different blink patterns on a LED.
  2. Use a button to change how a pot controls an LED. The pot can change brightness or blink speed.
  3. A button starts a long LED blink pattern. Pressing the button during the pattern turns off the LED.
name: Coding Circuits
